description: An HR employee directory in the Svelte 5 data grid: about 80 people with avatar and name, title, level, team, manager, location, start date, a derived tenure column, status and compensation. It groups by team, location or status through columnGroupingFeature with a default group-by, renders the avatar cell and status badge with renderSnippet, computes tenure with fieldFn rather than a stored field, and folds group rows to a summary line.

faq.question: How is the tenure column computed without a field?
faq.answer: The column has an id and a fieldFn that returns the tenure from the start date, so it sorts and filters like any other column while nothing is stored on the row.

faq.question: How do I set a default grouping?
faq.answer: Call api.setGroupBy(['team']) in onApiReady. The demo does this after the API arrives, and the toolbar buttons switch to location or status the same way.

faq.question: How are the avatar and badge rendered?
faq.answer: Each is a snippet returned from the column's cell function with renderSnippet. The person column combines the avatar and the name; the status column maps the value to a coloured badge.
